content.thinking: After 8 years the figures you entered are "28,800" for contributions, "34,412" for the balance, and tax "0", which you're happy with. I'm flagging that the text mentions a track called "במסלול מדד" and a 7% return that I can't verify, so please check those before relying on them.

input.answer: With 300 ₪ a month and no employer, the calculator showed about 15,162 ₪ in my hands after 4 years (I put in 14,400, and tax took 587) and about 34,412 ₪ after 8 years (I put in 28,800, no tax). But the "עצמאים" button wouldn't switch, so I made it myself by putting the employer at 0, and these numbers assume 7% a year in a "מסלול מדד". I'd ask you or the bank before acting on it.

stuck.why: I pressed 'עצמאים' four times, by name and by place, and 'שכירים' kept its tick. I never got the self-employed version, so I set 'הפקדת המעסיק' to 0 myself to get around it.

As a self-employed person I don't have a 'משכורת ברוטו', and it asks for a percentage of salary, not an amount in shekels. I left 12,000 and 2.5% (300 ₪ a month) because I didn't know what else to put.

stuck.where: First result chart (before I changed anything)
stuck.why: It showed '900 ₪ מהמעסיק' and a red striped '−13,974'. That frightened me and showed me it wasn't working out my case.

structured_output.answer: With 300 ₪ a month and no employer, the calculator showed about 15,162 ₪ in my hands after 4 years (I put in 14,400, and tax took 587) and about 34,412 ₪ after 8 years (I put in 28,800, no tax). But the "עצמאים" button wouldn't switch, so I made it myself by putting the employer at 0, and these numbers assume 7% a year in a "מסלול מדד". I'd ask you or the bank before acting on it.

stuck.why: I pressed 'עצמאים' four times, by name and by place, and 'שכירים' kept its tick. I never got the self-employed version, so I set 'הפקדת המעסיק' to 0 myself to get around it.

As a self-employed person I don't have a 'משכורת ברוטו', and it asks for a percentage of salary, not an amount in shekels. I left 12,000 and 2.5% (300 ₪ a month) because I didn't know what else to put.
